subject: 12-6-4LJ for thermodynamic integration on PMEMD engine

messages.author: Paulius Kantakevicius
messages.body:
Hello,
Does AMBER18 support 12-6-4LJ potentials for thermodynamic integration (TI)
on PMEMD engine? I was reading the article on AMBER18 developments
https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC6226240/
, which suggested
that they added support of TI and 12-6-4LJ for PMEMD in AMBER18. However, I
can't find any mention whether you can use 12-6-4LJ potential during
thermodynamic integration simulations on PMEMD engine.
Sincerely,
Paulius

messages.author: Pengfei Li
messages.body:
Hi Paulius,
Yes, Amber18 does. You can try to do a 12-6-4 simulation using pmemd.cuda in Amber18 and check the output file.
Pengfei

messages.author: Song, Lin
messages.body:
Hi Paulius,
AMBER18 does support 12-6-4 for GPU TI. My experience is that for production, NVT condition can reproduce previous CPU TI results for metal ion solvation free energy. So if you use AMBER18, I’d suggest you use NVT in the production run.
Best,
Lin
